findings.title: Substring matching can upsample mixed event queries
findings.body: This treats any query containing `event.type:error` as error-only, including queries that also select transactions (for example, an OR between error and transaction types). The transformed aggregation sums `sample_weight`, which is not available for transaction events, so mixed queries can fail or return incorrect counts. Determine that the query is exclusively errors rather than checking for a substring.

findings.title: Cached allowlist eligibility can apply stale weighting
findings.body: The 60-second cache is not invalidated when the project allowlist changes, so a project removed from the allowlist can continue receiving weighted counts, and a newly allowlisted project can continue receiving ordinary counts, until the entry expires. The helper `invalidate_upsampling_cache` is not called by this change, so the cache can produce incorrect counts after configuration updates.
